description: The AGREE project publishes harmonised geospatial layers for Moncalieri, Hull and Lillehammer. Zenodo lists forty-four shapefile components free under CC BY 4.0. Categories cover heritage assets, flood risk, natural heritage areas, urban conservation zones and land use. National, local and European inputs are placed in a common multi-level GIS structure for comparison across the three case-study cities. These layers can supply built-asset exposure and land-use context in urban-flood simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this project database. Coverage is the selected Italian, British and Norwegian study areas, not a complete inventory of all assets there. Mixed source vintages, different local classifications and upstream rights need checking before cross-city comparisons. A hazard layer alone does not quantify individual building damage. No shapefile was downloaded or geometry checked.
